reviews.title: CarPlay issues with Duo
reviews.text: Just want to add to the list of people stating there are issues with CarPlay on the duo.  The arrival time box blocks out the immediate path, and when there is a warning of something coming up (road hazard, etc) it blocks even more of the immediate path.  Also, we must now hit the alternate route button twice to actually see alternate routes.  This one seems like it was a deliberate decision and not a bug and I HATE it.  That tiny alternate route button is hard enough to hit while driving, and now you're making me do it twice just to get to the menu that used to come up with one press?  And for what gain??  How is that user-friendly??  Words can't adequately describe how much I hate that decision.

I’ll put it to my house and it’ll send me to the most outrageous places making my route so much longer than what it needed to be so disappointed. I never expected it to go downhill.

reviews.title: Has gone downhill
reviews.text: Waze has become more frustrating than helpful. The app constantly suggests unnecessary turns and ridiculous detours just to supposedly save a few seconds. Half the time, these routes actually take longer than simply following Google Maps. It frequently recommends inefficient routes that make absolutely no sense. What used to be a reliable navigation app has become an inconvenience. I shouldn’t have to second-guess my GPS every time I drive. Google Maps consistently gets me to my destination faster and with fewer unnecessary turns. I’ve completely lost confidence in Waze, and I’m officially uninstalling it. Very disappointing!

reviews.title: Avoid the app extremely frustrating  unreliable app
reviews.text:
Waze has become a very disappointing navigation app. The directions are often inaccurate, it sometimes sends you through unnecessary detours, and the estimated arrival times are not reliable. Instead of saving time, it can end up wasting your time and causing unnecessary stress.

The app can also be confusing, and the constant changes in routes are frustrating, especially when driving in busy areas. A navigation app should make driving easier, not more complicated.

reviews.title: What's happened?
reviews.text: I have used Waze for the last year and a half and loved it – always took me the shorter route given the traffic. More recently both me and my husband have both noticed that it isn't the shorter route anymore. It gets fixated on a route because it planned that first or because you've used it consistently before.  Eventually driving in a different direction will override it and save you 15 minutes.  I'm not a creature of habit. I like to take different routes to save time when the traffic is bad which is why I use a sat nav.  Even the alternate routes are fixated on what I've done before and Wade is adamant to take me in that direction even if it takes longer. Again, newer behaviour  I'm also having to run the route through other satnavs now before leaving.

reviews.title: RUTAS
reviews.text:
Problemas con CarPlay después de actualizar a iOS 27

Desde que actualicé mi iPhone 17 Pro Max a iOS 27, Apple Maps en CarPlay tiene varios problemas. Los botones de la parte derecha de la pantalla, como el de búsqueda y el de las rutas alternativas, aparecen prácticamente transparentes y no se pueden utilizar correctamente.

Además, en CarPlay ya no puedo ver ni seleccionar las rutas alternativas. Solo aparece una ruta, mientras que en el iPhone las rutas alternativas siguen apareciendo y funcionan correctamente.

Es muy molesto, especialmente al conducir, porque antes podía seleccionar fácilmente una ruta alternativa directamente desde CarPlay.

Por favor, Apple, solucionad estos problemas de CarPlay y Apple Maps en una próxima actualización.

reviews.title: Waze freezes the screen and blocks other apps on the phone
reviews.text:
I accidentally updated the app. Since the update, previous and current update, the screen freezes when I start the app. I open the app, try to select route (saved or a new one) and the screen freezes. Keyboard does not work, microphone does not work, back button does not work. Everything is blocked. I can’t even use just the map, without any route selected. This too is blocked (frozen). If I have any other apps open on the phone, these get affected too. Are you trying to download information from my phone? Why are you blocking my other apps as well? Yours is not working properly, and any other opened app on my phone gets affected too. The only way to have a proper working phone is to close Waze, close all other apps, restart the phone then open all other apps again, without opening Waze.  I regret updating so much. What was wrong with the other version? Please make it possible to downgrade to a version of the app that worked as smooth as a swish watch. 
I don’t want the current version. It freezes and messes up everything on my phone. 
I am obviously not using Waze anymore and I am beginning to like the alternatives better. I get better route suggestions, it has better functionality and is lighter on mobile data consumptions. reviews.title: App not updating in real time
reviews.text:
I’ve relied on Waze for years, but over the last two weeks I’ve had several serious navigation issues. The app has repeatedly failed to update routes in real time, taking me to the wrong locations and not recognising road closures.

Most recently, I searched for “Brighton Hospital” and Waze routed me towards the wrong destination, wasting a significant amount of time. On another journey, it instructed me to take an exit at a roundabout even though that road was closed. By the time I realised, I was forced into a different lane and had to continue without knowing where I was going because it didn’t reroute quickly enough.

Real-time traffic and road closure updates are the main reason people use a navigation app. Unfortunately, Waze has become unreliable for me, and after several incidents in a short period, I’ve lost confidence in using it. I hope these issues are addressed soon because it used to be my go-to navigation app.

reviews.title: I don't get the attraction to this app.
reviews.text:
My friend loves this app and swears by it, and I honestly don't understand why. It is so so so slow to calculate routes. And it does a lot of root calculation because it apparently can't seem to remember that I save a drive from one point to another so that I have it when I need it. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to ever save the departure point and insists on calculating it from where I am now. I'm trying to pre-plan, and pre-planning means I'm not where I'm going to be when I need the route. This would be a fairly minor annoyance if it didn't take multiple minutes for it to calculate when I change the departure point. It's nearly instantaneous when I do it on Google maps, so it's not my Internet connection. And let's not even go into the fact of how much more information is available on Google maps about places and points of interest and so on. I mean, the little Waze icons are cute. I'll give you that. But it doesn't make up for the utter lack of functionality.

PS: it's really interesting how all the reviews displayed by default are so glowing. When you change from "most relevant" to "most recent", you see a different picture. I don't know exactly how most relevant is calculated, but I'm willing to bet it has something to do with $$.

reviews.title: War mal gut
reviews.text: Stell dir vor, du kommst an eine Kreuzung und auf der Strasse, in die du fahren möchtest, geht es nicht weiter - Baustelle, Unfall, irgendwas. Aber kein Problem, dafür navigierst du ja mit WAZE - unmittelbare Eingabe der Sperrung, um eine Umleitung berechnen zu lassen und das System und andere User zu informieren. Aber dann stellst da fest: du kannst die Strasse nicht sperren, die App bietet den Button nicht mehr an. Es lassen sich nur einzelne Spuren sperren. Du suchst den Button an anderen Stellen, zweifelst an deiner Zurechnungsfähigkeit, du startest die App neu. Schau her, in der CarPlay-App bleibt er verschwunden, aber auf dem Smartphone, da ist er ja. Aber dann werden dir die Pfeile, auf die du wie gewohnt klicken willst, um die blockierten Richtungen zu markieren, AM ANDEREN ENDE der Strasse, an der Kreuzung jenseits der Sperrung angezeigt, und keiner davon zeigt wenigstens in die Richtung der gesperrten Strasse, damit du sie zumindest aus der anderen Richtung als gesperrt markieren kannst. Du kurvst auf deiner Kreuzung herum, aber die App weigert sich, Editier-Möglichkeiten für deine Richtung anzubieten. Waze war einmal eine gute App, weil das unmittelbare lokale Userfeedback zu sehr schneller Information anderer User führte. Aber das, was sie nach der Kaputt-Entwicklung noch kann, können die Konkurrenten deutlich besser: viel bessere Ansagen, viel bessere Live-Daten, viel mehr und genauere Ansage von Gefahrenstellen, viel bessere Einbindung in die Infrastruktur des A
